description: Risk-check an ERC-20 before trading it: metadata, contract + ownership status, upgradeable-proxy detection, holder concentration, and a transfer/honeypot simulation → risk signals + a score. The deep checks (concentration, honeypot) are heavy: needs NODEFLARE_API_KEY or X402_PRIVATE_KEY. Works on young chains (Zircuit, Robinhood, Plasma, Ink) that big indexers leave empty.

chain.description: Chain — slug (eth, base, robinhood…), name, or chain ID

name: check_token_safety
